subject: STABLE encode-cpu-opus: offset-key plan templates landed in shared tree (gate-green 14:24-15:05); HEAVY RELEASE
body:
GATES (shared tree, after C6p 63a5682 + these changes)
- run_host_tests: 'all offline GPU tests passed', including the iOS bundle strict link.
- CA: PASS with TEGU_PLAN_MEMO_VERIFY on (every hit re-planned in full; 0 mismatches).
- Render: 32 baseline. Async: 6/6.
- Integration: only the known CA pass failure (checks=1005, required_failures=2).

FILES (md5)
- render_pipeline.inc 5b2d9c22
- render_encoder.inc 158f9dae: the TEGU_PERF_PLANMISS line now also reports tmpl, tmpl_refused and tmpl_hit.
- air_bridge.rs f7ac786c, air_bridge.h 12dcb2ae: new additive export tegu_air_render_pipeline_plan_generic_buffer_templates.
- tools/frame_bench_main.m 131f33e8: FB_OFFSET_RING plus the FB_PLAN line.

ROOT ACTION: translator patch
- File: build/compile-stall-20261026/offset-templates/translator-buffer-slot-templates.patch (a0fbaac5).
- It is APPLIED UNCOMMITTED in references/metal2vulkan-tegu-pin and gpu/build/metal2vulkan.
- Please commit it and bump PIN in metal/tegu/build_air_bridge.py.

LIBS REBUILT FROM THESE BYTES (with the translator patch)
- Shared host cdylib: 7d644dac.
- iOS archive research/nord2-native-air/.../libtegu_air_bridge.a: 9083e3be.
- build/compute-v2-producer-current-abi receipt regenerated: 7/7 cases. This is the integration 'candidate provenance' gate.

KILL SWITCH
- NORD2_METAL_PLAN_TEMPLATES=0.

MEASURED (host, frame_bench FB_OFFSET_RING=1)
- Plan-memo misses: 5895 -> 9 over 7750 lookups.
- ca200 encode CPU: 1796 -> 530 us/frame.
- Device c6m context: offset-only misses were 93% of all misses.

NOTE
- build/native/Nord2Metal.bundle/Nord2Metal is now this run's gate output. The C6p binary remains in the C6p package.
